samples.xml_description:
<module id="div_8bit">
    <description>Implement a simplified radix-2 divider on 8-bit signed or unsigned integers.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="clk">Clock signal used for synchronous operation.</input>
        <input id="rst">The reset signal to initialize or reset the module.</input>
        <input id="sign">1-bit indicates if the operation is signed (1) or unsigned (0).</input>
        <input id="dividend" width_description="[7:0]">8-bit input signal representing the dividend for division.</input>
        <input id="divisor" width_description="[7:0]">8-bit input signal representing the divisor for division.</input>
        <input id="opn_valid">1-bit indicates that a valid operation request is present.</input>
        <input id="res_ready">1-bit indicates that the 16-bit output result has already been acknowledged.</input>
        <output id="res_valid">1-bit output signal indicating the result is valid and ready.</output>
        <output id="result" width_description="[15:0]">16-bit the output containing the remainder in the upper 8 bits and the quotient in the lower 8 bits.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter name="IDLE"/>
        <parameter name="LOAD"/>
        <parameter name="DIVIDE"/>
        <parameter name="STORE"/>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="sequential_logic">
        <reg id="SR" width="9"/> <!-- Shift Register -->
        <reg id="NEG_DIVISOR" width="9"/> <!-- Negated Divisor -->
        <reg id="cnt" width="4"/> <!-- Counter -->
        <reg id="start_cnt" width="1"/> <!-- Start Counter Flag -->
        <reg id="quotient" width="8"/> <!-- Quotient -->
        <reg id="remainder" width="8"/> <!-- Remainder -->
        <reg id="abs_dividend" width="9"/> <!-- Absolute Value of Dividend -->
        <reg id="abs_divisor" width="9"/> <!-- Absolute Value of Divisor -->
        <reg id="carry_out" width="1"/> <!-- Carry Out from Subtraction -->
        <reg id="temp_result" width="9"/> <!-- Temporary Result for Multiplexer -->
        <reg id="current_state" width="3"/> <!-- Current State of FSM -->
    </logic_description>
    <implementation>
        always @(posedge clk or posedge rst) begin
            if (rst) begin
                current_state <= IDLE;
                SR <= 0;
                NEG_DIVISOR <= 0;
                cnt <= 0;
                start_cnt <= 0;
                quotient <= 0;
                remainder <= 0;
                abs_dividend <= 0;
                abs_divisor <= 0;
                carry_out <= 0;
                temp_result <= 0;
                res_valid <= 0;
                result <= 0;
            end else begin
                case (current_state)
                    IDLE: begin
                        if (opn_valid && !res_valid) begin
                            current_state <= LOAD;
                            abs_dividend <= {1'b0, dividend};
                            abs_divisor <= {1'b0, divisor};
                            if (sign == 1'b1) begin
                                abs_dividend <= ~abs_dividend + 1;
                                abs_divisor <= ~abs_divisor + 1;
                            end
                        end
                    end
                    LOAD: begin
                        SR <= {abs_dividend[7], abs_dividend[7:0]};
                        NEG_DIVISOR <= {~abs_divisor[7], abs_divisor[7:0]};
                        cnt <= 1;
                        start_cnt <= 1;
                        current_state <= DIVIDE;
                    end
                    DIVIDE: begin
                        if (start_cnt) begin
                            if (cnt == 8) begin
                                quotient <= SR[7:0];
                                remainder <= SR[15:8];
                                current_state <= STORE;
                            end else begin
                                SR <= {SR[7], SR[7:0] - NEG_DIVISOR};
                                if (SR[8]) begin
                                    SR <= {SR[7], SR[7:0] + NEG_DIVISOR};
                                    temp_result <= {1'b1, SR[7:0]};
                                end else begin
                                    temp_result <= {1'b0, SR[7:0]};
                                end
                                SR <= {temp_result[8], SR[7:0]};
                                cnt <= cnt + 1;
                            end
                        end
                    end
                    STORE: begin
                        SR <= {remainder, quotient};
                        start_cnt <= 0;
                        current_state <= IDLE;
                    end
                endcase
            end
        end

        always @(posedge clk) begin
            if (rst) begin
                res_valid <= 0;
            end else begin
                if (cnt == 8) begin
                    res_ready <= 1;
                end else if (res_valid && res_ready) begin
                    res_valid <= 0;
                end else begin
                    res_valid <= 1;
                end
            end
        end

        result <= {remainder, quotient};
    </implementation>
</module>
